# §1 — =/≠ → / = ( = =/≠ ≠ )

## #0 — Identification has material

The input is the minimal inscription developed in [−/−](minus-over-minus.md): two strokes and an oblique relating mark. File 1 §1 asks what these elements must do for something to be identified across difference. The [Binary Explication house](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) sources the construction; [Self-Identity](../../self-identity.md) grounds its whole relation.

The copula is the identifying activity expressed in “is.” Bringing `=` into its formal account isolates an operation shared by predication and equations: distinguishable terms are held in one claim. It does not make all uses of “is” numerical equality.

## #1 — Compose equality and difference

Gather the two strokes in parallel to form `=`. Read the oblique stroke `/` as cut, spacing, and differentiation. Cross `=` with `/` to form `≠`. The third sign is composed from the first two operations: difference is visibly identity under cut.

The construction gives two primitives rather than three unrelated signs. It also makes an obligation visible: identification must retain the distance across which it identifies. In `3 = 1+2`, the expressions differ as inscriptions while naming the same number. Their numerical equality specifies the respect in which the identification holds.

## #2 — Relate the identifying operations

Write `=/≠` to hold identity and non-identity in relation. The resulting expansion is:

$$
/ = (\;=\; =/\ne\; \ne\;).
$$

The first `=` inside the brackets supplies identity as a pole; the last `≠` supplies difference as a pole; the middle `=/≠` exposes each to the other. The brackets instruct the reader to hold the whole field as one relation. The outer equality states that this held activity explicates the slash.

The claim is Derived in the native mark calculus. Its graphical composition makes the operations inspectable; it does not prove a theorem of an independently axiomatized algebra simply by borrowing that algebra's familiar signs.

## #3 — Count the appearances without losing the operators

Open the middle hinge for the analytic count. It gives equality-in-relation-to-difference and difference-in-relation-to-equality. Together with the two outer poles, there are four visible appearances. The original `/` and `=` remain operative in their composition.

Thus the result is **four appearances plus two operative marks**, `4+2=6`. Counting the middle as two is a declared operation. Holding it as one hinge will give another reading, rather than a contradictory answer to an unspecified counting question. [Harmonics and recount](harmonics-and-recount.md) extends that transition.

## #4 — The subject–object copula

File 1 applies the relation to knowing through `Ø/X` and `(0/Ø)/(1/X)`. Here `0` marks unobjectifiable subject-position, `Ø` the apparent subject formed through the inner instrument, `1` the determinate mark, and `X` the wider object-field. The upper inner relation distinguishes subject-position from apparent subject; the lower distinguishes the determinate mark from its field. The outer slash holds their knowing relation together.

These are File 1’s local symbol assignments. The [core §IX recognition sequence](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) develops `1/X` as integrated unity over the cut object-field: the same notation now bears the object-side recognition that culminates in affirmed `1`. The initial mark and the recognised unity must be distinguished when passing between these developments. The `X` of this object-field cannot silently replace the determining-capacity `X` of the earlier `X/x` reading. The [immutable-subject projection](immutable-subject.md) and [subject-logics root](../../subject-logics.md) extend the specific traversal through which the instrument becomes recognisable as medium.

## #5→0 — The act can account for itself

The copula has supplied a countable field without turning relation into an additional substance between its terms. Its result returns to identification: a mark can make a claim, exhibit the respect in which it holds, and remain exposed to the circumstance that makes its difference intelligible.

This projection returns-to [A02](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) and [Movement02, Define the Subject](../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/02-s01-p1-define-subject.md). It also returns-to [A18](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md), where the count receives its complete qualitative field. The short definitional chain retains its own vantage; the processual inverse phase is developed in the Process folder.
